items.question: What change in Narada follows hearing the minister's spoken words?
items.inference: Hearing the minister's speech leaves Narada glad-minded.
uncertainties: The exact grammatical case of hṛṣṭamanasaḥ is not fully resolved from the fused form alone.
items.plain_english: Having heard this, Narada, spoken to by the minister, became glad-minded.
